run_odom_demo_main: run the main function to launch the monocular odometry demo with a Realsense dataset and Open3D visualization window
create_RealsenseDataset: create a RealsenseDataset instance with a given image size and Realsense YAML configuration for live camera odometry
create_OdomWindow: create an OdomWindow instance with visualization config, SLAM config, and a dataset for interactive odometry visualization
review_OdomWindow: review the OdomWindow class and its GUI controls for pause, next frame, normals toggle, and point cloud visualization
summarize_odom_demo: summarize the odom_demo module which loads YAML configs, initializes a RealsenseDataset, and runs an Open3D odometry visualization loop
